observations.body: Israel keeps Passover in Sinai’s wilderness; a question about uncleanness receives a second-month provision while resident foreigners share one statute.

payload.posture: Read Numbers 9:1–14 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Passover is kept at Sinai with provision for impurity belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
